title: araujia sericifera var. hortorum
intro: Araujia sericifera var. hortorum, commonly known as the "Sensitive Plant," is a type of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. The Sensitive Plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and provide antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the Sensitive Plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
